verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਟਿਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: so Tikaa so chhatr sir soiee sachaa takhat Tikaiee|

en.bdb: With the same mark (on the forehead), the same canopy he radiated on the Throne.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੰਦੀ ਮੁਹਰਿ ਹਥਿ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਦੀ ਦੋਹੀ ਫਿਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: gur naanak ha(n)dhee muhar hath gur a(n)gadh dhee dhohee firaiee|

en.bdb: The power Guru Nanak had is now with Guru Angad was publically proclaimed all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਤਾ ਛੋੜਿ ਕਰਤਾਰਪੁਰੁ ਬੈਠਿ ਖਡੂਰੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhitaa chhoR karataarapur baiTh khaddoore jot jagaiee|

en.bdb: Guru Angad left Kartarpur and scattered his light while sitting at Khadur.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ja(n)me poorab beejiaa vich vich hor kooRee chaturaiee|

en.bdb: Action seeds of the previous births sprout; all other ingenuinities are false.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਹਣੇ ਪਾਈ ਨਾਨਕੋ ਦੇਣੀ ਅਮਰਦਾਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: lahane paiee naanako dhenee amaradhaas ghar aaiee|

en.bdb: Whatever Lahina got from Guru Nanak now came to the house of (Guru) Amar Das.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਦਾਤਿ ਇਲਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: gur baiThaa amar saroop hoi gurmukh paiee dhaat ilaahee|

en.bdb: Having received the celestial gift from Guru Angad, the Guru, in the form of Amar Das is seated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫੇਰਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਗੋਇੰਦਵਾਲੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: fer vasaiaa goi(n)dhavaal acharaj khel na lakhiaa jaiee|

en.bdb: Guru Amar Das founded Goindval. The wondorous play could was beyond sight.
Gift received from the earlier Gurus further enhanced the grandeur of the Light.
